name: opencode-gemini-rotator
description: OpenCode plugin that rotates multiple Google Gemini API keys to bypass per-key rate limits (HTTP 429) and quota exhaustion (HTTP 403/503 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) — drop-in, transparent fetch interceptor with cooldown and TUI sidebar.
interact_justification: GitHub Issues + GitHub Discussions enabled; SUPPORT.md routes user questions to the right channel.
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md at repo root documents dev setup, contribution process, commit conventions, and PR checklist.
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents code-quality standards (strict TS, formatting, test requirements), commit-message convention, and PR submission process.
floss_license_justification: MIT — recognized OSI/FSF FLOSS license. See LICENSE file.
license_location_justification: LICENSE file at repo root; SPDX-identifiable as MIT.
documentation_basics_justification: README.md covers what the project does, why, install, configuration, how it works, troubleshooting, FAQ, security, contributing, license.
documentation_interface_justification: README documents the plugin configuration schema (keys, logFile), all environment variables (OPENCODE_GEMINI_DEBUG, GEMINI_API_KEYS), and behavior of every public option.
sites_https_justification: All project sites (github.com, npmjs.com) serve via HTTPS.
discussion_justification: GitHub Issues + Discussions enabled; SUPPORT.md describes channels.
english_justification: All documentation and code is in English.
maintained_justification: Active solo maintenance; commits within the last 30 days; releases happen via release-please automation.
repo_track_justification: Git is a distributed version-control system.
repo_interim_justification: Interim commits made between releases; full per-commit history visible.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique semver tag (v1.0.0, v1.1.0, v1.1.1).
version_semver_justification: Project uses Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (release-please enforces this).
version_tags_justification: Git tags vX.Y.Z for each release.
release_notes_justification: CHANGELOG.md follows Keep-a-Changelog format; GitHub Releases auto-generate notes from PRs via release-please.
release_notes_vulns_justification: Release notes call out fixed vulnerabilities when applicable; project has had no security advisories to date.
report_process_justification: SUPPORT.md routes bug reports to the GitHub Issues bug-report template; the template requires repro, version, and OS information.
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues with structured bug + feature templates.
report_responses_justification: Single-maintainer project with best-effort response times documented in SUPPORT.md (2 weeks for bugs).
enhancement_responses_justification: SUPPORT.md and CONTRIBUTING.md describe how feature requests are handled.
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues are publicly archived and queryable.
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md documents two private channels: GitHub Security Advisory (preferred) and email.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub Security Advisories provide private reporting; private vulnerability reporting is enabled on the repo.
build_justification: `bun run build` produces dist/. Documented in README and CONTRIBUTING.
build_floss_tools_justification: All build tooling (Bun, TypeScript, vitest, prettier, eslint, knip) is FLOSS.
test_justification: Vitest test suite: 29 unit + property-based tests covering routing, header normalization, cooldown, rotation, log redaction, and abort handling.
test_invocation_justification: `bun run test` documented in README and CONTRIBUTING.
test_most_justification: ~80% line coverage on src/server.ts (the core surface); property-based tests cover invariants over thousands of random inputs.
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions CI runs typecheck + lint + format + tests + build on every PR and push to main; matrix across Ubuntu and macOS.
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states: 'Tests required. Any new feature or bug fix should include a test.'
tests_are_added_justification: Test count grew from 5 to 29 over the project history alongside feature commits.
tests_documented_added_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md describes test files and what each covers.
warnings_justification: tsc --strict + ESLint with typescript-eslint, security, promise, and n plugins. CI fails on any warning.
warnings_fixed_justification: Zero warnings across lint + typecheck on current main.
warnings_strict_justification: tsconfig: strict, noImplicitOverride, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch. ESLint flat-config with security + promise + n plugins.
know_secure_design_justification: Project follows least-privilege design: fetch interceptor scoped to a single hostname; narrow GitHub Action permissions; zod-validated config boundary prevents prototype pollution; secrets are masked in all output.
know_common_errors_justification: OWASP Top 10 and common credential-handling pitfalls are understood. Specifically addressed: SSRF (allowlist a single hostname), input validation (zod), credential leakage (log redaction tests).
crypto_published_justification: Software does not implement cryptographic functions; it forwards bearer tokens / API keys to Google's API over HTTPS.
crypto_call_justification: Software does not call cryptographic functions directly; HTTPS is handled by the Node.js standard library / OpenSSL.
crypto_floss_justification: See above; no direct cryptographic dependencies.
crypto_keylength_justification: No keys are generated by the project; it forwards user-supplied API keys to Google.
crypto_working_justification: No cryptographic algorithms are implemented by the project.
crypto_pfs_justification: HTTPS to Google's API; PFS is Google's responsibility.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Project does not store passwords. User-supplied API keys are kept in memory only.
crypto_random_justification: Project does not use cryptographic randomness; rotation order is deterministic.
delivery_mitm_justification: Package is delivered via npm registry over HTTPS with SLSA provenance attestation (OIDC trusted publishing); GitHub Release also serves the signed tarball.
delivery_unsigned_justification: SLSA provenance attestation is generated automatically on every release via npm trusted publishing. The .intoto.jsonl file is attached to each GitHub Release.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No vulnerabilities currently known; dependabot + bun audit + osv-scanner + CodeQL run continuously.
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities. Transitive CVE in qs was already preemptively overridden in package.json.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: gitleaks runs on every push (working tree + full history); GitHub secret-scanning + push-protection enabled; no real credentials in history (verified by audit).
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL runs on every push, every PR, and weekly. Also: ESLint + typescript-eslint + eslint-plugin-security in CI.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL javascript-typescript suite includes the security-extended queries covering OWASP Top 10.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every push and PR (not just weekly).
dynamic_analysis_justification: Project does not have a dedicated dynamic-analysis (fuzzing/DAST) pipeline. Property-based testing via fast-check provides partial coverage of the parser surface, but there is no Stryker-style mutation analysis enforced in CI.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: TypeScript / Node.js — memory-safe runtime; unsafe-language sanitizers don't apply.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests run with assertions on; zod schema enforces runtime validation at the trust boundary.
